data.name: Raghadah
data.gender_notes: Raghadah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raghadah means 'delicate, graceful' in Arabic. It is a beautiful name inspired by nature, specifically flowers, which are known for their fragility and beauty. The name Raghadah carries the meaning “Delicate, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raghadah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raghadah represents the delicate balance of life and the graceful way in which we navigate the world around us. It is a reminder to be mindful of our actions and to treat others and the world with care and respect.
data.etymology: Raghadah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raghadah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رغدة
in_arabic.meaning: رغدة تعني الراحة و السعادة و الرفاهية في الحياة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رغدة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الراحة و السعادة و الرفاهية في الحياة. و هو مشتق من الفعل رغد الذي يعني الرفاهية و الرخاء. و قد ورد ذكر الفعل رغد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 168 و هي قول الله تعالى: 'وَأَذِقُوا النَّاسَ حُسْنَ الْحَدِيثِ'

in_urdu.name: رغدہ
in_urdu.meaning: رغدہ مطلب ہے راحت، خوشی اور زندگی میں خوشحالی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رغدہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے راحت، خوشی اور زندگی میں خوشحالی۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

Historically, the name Raghadah has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a life of ease and joy.
